This is not a sign of civilizational health.


Jim VandeHei (@JimVandeHei)

🚨 Potential 2028 Democratic presidential candidates are introducing themselves to voters in a striking way: by documenting their childhood resentments, family chaos and fights with their parents. axios.com/2026/03/22/democra…




— https://nitter.net/JimVandeHei/status/2035839603307958640#m

Just rewatched World War Z. Does make me wonder how RFK Jr. would respond to a vaccine driven strategy to fight the zombie apocalypse. “Sure, the vaccine prevents you from being eaten by zombies, but do you really want to roll the dice with a vaccine?”

Totally true. I also expected to spend much more time talking about, and dealing with, quicksand. 

And, frankly, when I was a kid I thought that when I grew up, I’d have to deal with the risks of transporting nitroglycerin. Hasn’t frick’n come up once.


claire (@rosiekennedyxx)

Nobody fell off harder than the hammerhead shark. Was a top shark for me as a kid and now completely obsolete in media and conversation.



— https://nitter.net/rosiekennedyxx/status/2035329891827142787#m

“Hello. It’s Sunday. The people went away last night and came back smelling like good meat and big dogs. We would have given them a welcoming committee all the same but we had been watching the dog TV (you call it an open window) and the wind blew the door closed and we got locked in. When we were set free we smelled the smells and were very cross. But I think they brought bones home, so we will see what we get. All in all just poor behavior all around.  Also I love you.”

Final round of negotiations  this morning

Video

Often, when Trump does something truly vile and indefensible, I think of the intellectual poseur and Trump sycophant Tom Klingenstein who explained that real men, serious men, patriotic men, don’t support Trump for his policies, but for the “rest of him.” You know the part of him that does and says the indefensible things. 

americanmind.org/salvo/trump…
Had a wonderful dinner at @asymmetricinfo and @petersuderman’s house. Fantastic food and drinks. But highlight was finally meeting the beasts (who love bombed my wife).
“Good morning. It’s Friday. Don’t be frightened by my collar. It’s for scaring away mean dogs. At least that’s what they told me. Also, I love you.”
I forgot I’ve had an account here since 2023. Kicking the tires now.
Giving this a whirl. This is my first Bluesky post and, yes, I'm tweeting pictures of my dogs. Don't say you weren't warned.
